# SARKSH GROW

SARKSH GROW is operated by SARKSH GROW FIN-TECH PRIVATE LIMITED, a Hyderabad-based FinTech company building product-first financial technology.

## Current product pages
- [SARKSH Trade](https://www.sarksh.in/sarksh-trade.html) — trading and market-access product pathway.
- [SARKSH Stream](https://www.sarksh.in/sarksh-stream.html) — product in development; detailed scope will be published when finalized.
- [SARKSH Velocity](https://www.sarksh.in/sarksh-velocity.html) — SARKSH Data historical market-intelligence product.

## Product boundary
SARKSH GROW does not promise guaranteed returns or personalized stock recommendations. Public claims about regulated broking or other regulated services are made only when the relevant approval and compliance layer is ready.
